title: NntpQueue drain silently drops read_dir errors
description: queue.rs drain_once line 198 uses 'while let Ok(Some(entry)) = dir.next_entry().await' which collapses Err variants into loop termination with no log or metric. This commit explicitly fixed relay_queue.rs to use explicit match Ok(Some)/Ok(None)/Err for the same pattern. NntpQueue was not updated. A transient filesystem error during directory scan silently terminates the drain scan early, potentially skipping queued articles without any operator-visible signal.
